title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with permission to view and edit containers and at least one container…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where a user with permissions to view and edit containers and at least one container label can set misleading user and app provenance on containers they create. This occurs because the REST API accepts client-supplied values for server-managed container fields, allowing the user to also infer the existence of user IDs and installed app identifiers.
